fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown to users when they pick a bot.

fields.label: Allowed Roles
fields.description: Leave empty to let every desk user use this bot.

fields.label: Debug Mode
fields.description: Store tool calls, arguments and raw errors on each reply and show them in the chat.

fields.label: Provider
fields.options:
Ollama
OpenAI
OpenAI Compatible
LM Studio
LocalAI
fields.description: Leave empty to use the provider set in Support AI Settings.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Leave empty to use the provider's model from Support AI Settings.

fields.label: Engine
fields.description: Built-in: lightweight loop tuned for small local models. OpenAI Agents SDK: required for Code Interpreter, Web Search and OpenAI vector-store File Search.

fields.label: Reasoning Effort
fields.description: Only for reasoning models (e.g. OpenAI o-series / gpt-5). Leave empty for normal models.

fields.label: Dynamic Instructions
fields.description: Render the instruction as Jinja: {{ first_name }}, {{ full_name }}, {{ email }}, {{ user_id }}, {{ roles }}, {{ company }}, {{ employee_id }}, {{ department }}, {{ employee_company }}, {{ lang }}, {{ today }}, {{ now }}, {{ reference_doctype }}, {{ reference_name }}.

fields.label: Replace Default System Prompt
fields.description: Use only this bot's instruction. Otherwise it is added after the system prompt from Support AI Settings.

fields.label: Include Built-in Record Lookup
fields.description: The read-only lookup_records tool for find/list/latest questions.

fields.label: Include Document Diagnostics
fields.description: Send permissions, workflow, error logs and custom code of the referenced document.

fields.label: Allow Write Actions
fields.description: Allow functions that create/update/delete/submit/cancel documents. They still only run for users who have the Support AI write role AND normal DocType permission. Every write is recorded in Support AI Action Log.

fields.label: Enable File Search
fields.description: Answer from the files below. With OpenAI + Agents SDK the files are synced to an OpenAI vector store; with any other provider they are searched locally on this server.

fields.label: OpenAI Hosted Tools
fields.description: Require Provider = OpenAI and Engine = OpenAI Agents SDK.

fields.label: Use Google Document AI for Attachments
fields.description: OCR / parse attached images and PDFs with Google Document AI (configure credentials in Support AI Settings).

fields.label: Document AI Processor ID
fields.description: Empty = default processor from Support AI Settings.
